rule: Adverts page explicitly states 'This item has been sold'. Treat as confirmed sale. Do not assume asking price equals realized price.
Adverts page explicitly states item sold and a concrete accepted offer is visible. Treat accepted offer as likely realized price unless later contradictory comments exist.
Seller explicitly marks item/subset Sold in description. Strong sale evidence, but realized price unknown unless separately shown.
Concrete offer accepted but no platform sold state. Do not treat as confirmed sale; PM/DM acceptance can later fall through.
Contact/PM placeholder only. Not sale evidence.
Disappearance alone is not sale evidence; could be withdrawn, expired, relisted or deleted.
Asking price only. Use as local retail ceiling/behavioural reference, not realized sale value.
